name: skin-path-vesta
comment: Redirect the shell's baked-in skin resource paths from res/img/Itelma/MMC27/... to res/img/Itelma/VESTA/... so G3NavHMI renders our custom skin. Global find/replace: 'MMC27' and 'VESTA' are both 5 chars, so every hit keeps its length and no file offsets shift (no string-table reflow). The pattern is anchored as 'Itelma/MMC27' so the 2 unrelated build-path strings ('d:\cm_wark\MMC27 E AND G\...') are NOT touched. Verified in Ghidra: the 424 path records (40-byte records at file 0x322FE4+, VA 0x7241E4) are referenced by code (literal pool at VA 0x6E1DA4..0x6E1DF4 and a table pointer loaded at VA 0x6DFD94).

patches.comment: skin resource table -> VESTA folder (5 chars in, 5 chars out)
